title: Q: Nitrogen forms five oxides with oxygen (0.572 g, 1.14 g, 1.73 g, 2.28 g, 2.85 g of O per 1.09 g of N) — show how these illustrate the law of multiple proportions
notes: Fixed mass of nitrogen = 1.09 g in all five oxides
This simple whole-number ratio illustrates the **Law of Multiple Proportions**
